span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Because feature tuning co-varies within single neurons, a gain applied to individual cells cannot separate the two features; only re-weighting neurons at the population level recovers a feature-specific signal.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Mixed selectivity cancels the average effect of feature-specific gain, which is why single-neuron measures show nothing while the population does.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The attentional benefit is carried by higher-order correlations among neurons, i.e. it is an emergent property of the ensemble rather than a sum of single-cell effects.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Population coding unfolds in stages over the stimulus: a fast feature-general change detection followed by finer feature discrimination.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The analysis uses only firing rate, not spike timing.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Because many bandwidth targets were also amplitude-modulated, phase locking could signal a target in both attention conditions, so the task may not have been demanding enough to reveal attentional effects on spike timing.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Neurons were pooled across sessions and trials resampled, so real correlated and intrinsic variability had to be reintroduced by modelling rather than measured simultaneously.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The task may be too easy to force attention-related changes in A1 temporal dynamics.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The two levels of analysis disagree on the same data: attention does not enhance the single-neuron representation, while the population analysis shows enhanced encoding.
span.note: what this limits: a single-neuron measurement used to decide whether attention enhances sensory encoding: in these data it does not, while the population-level analysis of the same recordings shows that it does
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The physical stimulus differs between animals, because the values were tailored to each subject's own psychophysical thresholds rather than fixed.
span.note: what this limits: pooling or comparing the two subjects at 'the same' stimulus level: the AM and ∆BW values were tailored per subject to that subject's own psychophysical thresholds
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The condition labels are defined by a sensitivity criterion, not by a physical quantity: 'near threshold' means the level at which d-prime equals 1.
span.note: what this limits: the near/above-threshold conditions as physical stimulus levels: they are defined by the subject's measured sensitivity, at d-prime = 1, ~1.2 and >1.5
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: An inclusion decision was made and checked, and the check is reported rather than the criterion being justified in advance.
span.note: what this limits: the unit count in this study: 58 single units held for only two blocks are included, and the authors report that removing them does not qualitatively change the results
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: per-subject psychophysical detection thresholds measured beforehand and used to set the stimulus values for single-unit recording, so neural responses are read against each animal's own perceptual scale

span.label: `conditions` / `variables` - THE TWO MOST GENERIC WORDS IN EXPERIMENTAL SCIENCE, BOTH STIPULATED LOCALLY AND IN ONE BREATH. `IN THE PRESENT STUDY WE REFER TO “CONDITIONS” AS DISTINCT COMBINATIONS of AM, ∆BW and context ... WE REFER TO “VARIABLES” AS THE THREE DIMENSIONS ALONG WHICH ALL CONDITIONS VARY.` **Neither word is being used oddly - both are being pinned**, because the analysis needs 26 of one and 3 of the other and the ordinary senses would collapse them. `IN THE PRESENT STUDY` is the paper marking the scope of its own stipulation, which is exactly the marker a cross-paper corpus needs and almost never gets. **A tag joining this record's `variables` to another paper's `variables` would join 3 dimensions to a table of measurements.**
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Individual A1 neurons carried mixed selectivity, encoding both the spectral and temporal sound features and the attention condition.

span.label: Attention was the variable with a significant main effect in the largest number of neurons, yet interactions with feature tuning were rare.

span.label: AM and bandwidth tuning were positively correlated across neurons, so a single neuron's rate cannot disambiguate which feature changed.
